title: The Cerebral Scarring Station
subtitle: Where scars are cut
text: The Station cuts scars from patterns and blanks. At Degree 4 it is raised as a Working craft. Build its frame beside the Cardinal Focus of a Greater Working floor or larger, seat a Sanguine Formation in the Focus and light Flint and an Iron Ingot in the braziers. Feed the frame 100 mL and the floor takes it.
